# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This batch of ~150 short call clips is overwhelmingly **internal/operational chatter** — vehicle loading, driver coordination, security-gate instructions, screw-stock counting, payment-follow-up reminders, Diwali-gift distribution, attendance/punching disputes, bill-copy handovers, and courier/porter coordination. Only a **minority (roughly 35-45 calls)** are genuine sales conversations: inbound enquiries for roofing sheets/PUF panels/polycarbonate/decking/screws, rate quotes, brand comparisons, dealer price negotiations, and payment-terms discussions tied to actual orders.

Because the real sales content is thin and repetitive, this KB is kept tight and grounded only in what was actually said. The company is **Crayon Roofing and Structures**, based in **Manali, Andarkuppam check post, Chennai**, and is essentially a **JSW-authorized dealer/fabricator** of metal roofing sheets, with secondary lines in PUF insulated panels, polycarbonate sheets, decking sheets, screws/fasteners, and some structural items (Perlins, MS/RHS pipes). Do not assume anything beyond what appears below — e.g., there is no evidence of large structural fabrication services; reps repeatedly state "material supply only, fabrication we don't do."

## Products & brand ladder

**1. Metal roofing sheets (core product) — JSW brand family**
- **Color On Plus** (JSW) — 0.47mm thickness, AZ150 aluminium-zinc coating, **15-month warranty**. Flagship/premium line. Colors: Sky Blue, Half White.
  - "Color On Plus உங்களுக்கு 15 months warranty வரும் சார்." [Color On Plus gives you 15 months warranty, sir]
- **Pragathi** (JSW) — AZ70 coating, **no warranty**, cheaper (~₹415-420 vs ₹445). Half White available; Grey NOT available in Pragathi.
  - "Pragathi வந்து உங்களுக்கு aluminum Zinc coating AZ 70 தான் வரும்." [Pragathi only comes with AZ70 coating]
- **Radiance** — sometimes out of stock; "Radiance-க்கும் warranty வராது" [Radiance doesn't carry warranty] — used as a fallback/entry option.
- **Color One** — used specifically for Grey crimp-profile items when Radiance/Pragathi don't have grey.
- **Asian / Indradhanush** (competitor/alternate brand, also stocked/traded by staff in some dealer-to-dealer calls) — 0.45mm thickness, cheaper, no JSW backing; staff is told "நீங்க வாங்க கூடாது... JSW authorized dealer" [you shouldn't buy outside brand, we're JSW authorized] when someone tries to source Asian stock.

**2. Decking sheets** — GP (galvanized plain, no color), 0.8mm/1mm/1.2mm thickness, standard width 960mm, sold per meter (not per kg); JSW make.

**3. Polycarbonate sheets** — Lexan brand, thicknesses 1.5mm/1.8mm/2mm, max standard length 15 ft, "embossed clear," sold per square meter.

**4. PUF insulated panels ("puff sheet")** — Roof panel width ~1m, Wall panel width ~1.15m (3.25 ft); colors Sky Blue/Half White; **supply-only, no fabrication/fitting service** ("material supply மட்டும் தாங்க sir, fabrication எங்க side வராது").

**5. Screws & fasteners** — Tata brand, self-drilling/self-tapping, double-thread (roofing) vs full-thread (structural/M8), sizes 1",
